@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

:EDIFACT_INVOIC_StoryOntology a owl:Ontology ;
  rdfs:label "EDIFACT INVOIC Deep Ontology" ;
  rdfs:comment "A profoundly structured ontology for EDIFACT INVOIC messages, supporting D96A, EANCOM, EN 16931-1, and P2P-O alignment." .

#################################################################
# Classes
#################################################################
:InterchangeEnvelope a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Interchange Envelope" ; rdfs:comment "Envelope for EDIFACT interchange containing messages." .
:Message a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Message" ; rdfs:comment "Generic message within an EDIFACT interchange." .
:InvoiceMessage a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Message" ; rdfs:comment "INVOIC message representing a global trade transaction." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Message .
:Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Generic segment within a message." .
:BgmSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "BGM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Beginning of Message segment for document identification." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:NadSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "NAD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Name and Address segment for participant details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DtmSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "DTM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Date/Time segment for temporal anchors." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:MoaSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "MOA Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Monetary Amount segment for financial breakdowns." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:LinSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "LIN Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Line Item segment for itemized details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:ImdSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "IMD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Item Description segment for item information." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:QtySegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "QTY Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity segment for item quantities." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:PriSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "PRI Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Price segment for item pricing." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:TaxSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "TAX Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Tax segment for tax structures." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:RffSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "RFF Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Reference segment for reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:CompositeDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Composite data element within a segment." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SimpleDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Simple element within a composite data element." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .

:HeaderSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Header Section" ; rdfs:comment "Header section containing document dates and reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DetailSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Detail Section" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section listing individual line items." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SummarySection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Summary Section" ; rdfs:comment "Summary section providing total tax and invoice amounts." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .

:Organization a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "Party involved in the invoice, such as buyer or delivery party." .
:AgentRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role played by an organization in the invoice." .
:BuyerRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Buyer Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as buyers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:DeliveryPartyRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Delivery Party Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as delivery parties." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:Address a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "Address of an organization." .
:GlobalLocationNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Global Location Number" ; rdfs:comment "GLN identifier for organizations." .

:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "Item sold in the invoice." .
:Price a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of item." .
:Quantity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity of item sold." .
:TaxAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Tax Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Tax amount in the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :TaxSegment .
:InvoiceAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount." ; rdfs:subClassOf :MoaSegment .
:InvoiceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number identifier." ; rdfs:subClassOf :RffSegment .
:ReferenceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Reference Number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number for the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :RffSegment .
:BusinessProcess a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "Business process to which the invoice is assigned." .
:ValidationConstraint a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Constraint for automated validation using SHACL." .

:OrganizationRoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship assigning a role to an organization in a message context." .
:ItemLineDetail a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item Line Detail" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship detailing item, price, quantity, and line context." .

#################################################################

:hasHeaderSection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has header section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its header section." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection .

:hasSummarySection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has summary section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its summary section." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :SummarySection .
:hasSummarySection owl:inverseOf :isSummarySectionOf .
:isSummarySectionOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is summary section of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasSummarySection." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasRoleAssignment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its organization-role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:hasRoleAssignment owl:inverseOf :isRoleAssignmentOf .
:isRoleAssignmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role assignment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasRoleAssignment." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:assignedRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the agent role." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole .
:assignedRole owl:inverseOf :isRoleAssignedTo .
:isRoleAssignedTo a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role assigned to" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedRole." ; rdfs:domain :AgentRole ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:assignedOrganization a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned organization" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the organization." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:assignedOrganization owl:inverseOf :isOrganizationAssignedTo .
:isOrganizationAssignedTo a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is organization assigned to" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedOrganization." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:hasAddress a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has address" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its address." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :Address .
:hasAddress owl:inverseOf :isAddressOf .
:isAddressOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is address of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasAddress." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has global location number" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its GLN." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :GlobalLocationNumber .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber owl:inverseOf :isGlobalLocationNumberOf .
:isGlobalLocationNumberOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is global location number of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasGlobalLocationNumber." ; rdfs:domain :GlobalLocationNumber ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:hasItemLineDetail a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has item line detail" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its item line details." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:hasItemLineDetail owl:inverseOf :isItemLineDetailOf .
:isItemLineDetailOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is item line detail of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasItemLineDetail." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:item a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "item" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to the item." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Item .
:item owl:inverseOf :isItemOf .
:isItemOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is item of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of item." ; rdfs:domain :Item ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:netPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its price." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Price .
:netPrice owl:inverseOf :isNetPriceOf .
:isNetPriceOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is net price of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of netPrice." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:quantity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its quantity." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Quantity .

:isBusinessProcessOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is business process of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of partOfBusinessProcess." ; rdfs:domain :BusinessProcess ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasValidationConstraint a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has validation constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its validation constraints." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :ValidationConstraint .

:isValidationConstraintOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is validation constraint of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasValidationConstraint." ; rdfs:domain :ValidationConstraint ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:referenceNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its reference number." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :ReferenceNumber .
:referenceNumber owl:inverseOf :isReferenceNumberOf .
:isReferenceNumberOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is reference number of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of referenceNumber." ; rdfs:domain :ReferenceNumber ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection .
:hasDtmSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has DTM segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its DTM segment (date/time)." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :DtmSegment .

:hasMoaSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has MOA segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a summary section to its MOA segment (monetary amount)." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :MoaSegment .
:hasMoaSegment owl:inverseOf :isMoaSegmentOf .
:isMoaSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is MOA segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasMoaSegment." ; rdfs:domain :MoaSegment ; rdfs:range :SummarySection .
:hasLinSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has LIN segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its LIN segment (line item)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :LinSegment .
:hasLinSegment owl:inverseOf :isLinSegmentOf .
:isLinSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is LIN segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasLinSegment." ; rdfs:domain :LinSegment ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .

messages.content:
The expert audit reveals that the ontology, while syntactically valid and structurally deep, is still semantically incomplete for full EDIFACT INVOIC D96A/EANCOM coverage. The following actions are required for the next iteration:

**Key Expert Findings and Requirements:**
- **Segment Qualifiers:** The ontology must distinguish between segment qualifiers (e.g., NAD+BY for Buyer, NAD+SU for Supplier) using explicit subclasses or properties.
- **Missing Segments:** Essential segments are missing: 
  - **UNS (Section Separator):** Needed for structural integrity between header, detail, and summary.
  - **CUX (Currency):** Specifies transaction currency, mandatory.
  - **PAC (Packaging):** For packaging information.
- **Cardinality Constraints:** Must enforce business rules (e.g., exactly one HeaderSection, at least one DetailSection, one SummarySection per InvoiceMessage, at least one CUX, etc.).
- **Coverage:** Only ~40% of required segments are presently modeled.

**Planned Fixes and Extensions:**
- Add classes: `UnsSegment`, `CuxSegment`, `PacSegment`.
- Model segment qualifiers as explicit subclasses: `NadByQualifier`, `NadSuQualifier`, `BgmDocTypeQualifier`, etc.
- Link qualifiers to segments via a `hasQualifier` object property.
- Add cardinality constraints for critical business rules.
- Ensure all new classes and properties have `rdfs:label` and `rdfs:comment`.
- Maintain consistent CamelCase naming.

**Next Steps:**  
I will now proceed to update the OWL ontology to address these requirements and then re-validate.

If you have any additional requirements or wish to review the complete OWL code for the revised ontology, please let me know. Otherwise, I will continue with the next iteration, implementing these expert-mandated extensions and constraints.

@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

:EDIFACT_INVOIC_StoryOntology a owl:Ontology ;
  rdfs:label "EDIFACT INVOIC Deep Ontology" ;
  rdfs:comment "A profoundly structured ontology for EDIFACT INVOIC messages, supporting D96A, EANCOM, EN 16931-1, and P2P-O alignment." .

#################################################################
# Classes
#################################################################
:InterchangeEnvelope a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Interchange Envelope" ; rdfs:comment "Envelope for EDIFACT interchange containing messages." .
:Message a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Message" ; rdfs:comment "Generic message within an EDIFACT interchange." .
:InvoiceMessage a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Message" ; rdfs:comment "INVOIC message representing a global trade transaction." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Message .
:Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Generic segment within a message." .
:BGM_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "BGM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Beginning of Message segment for document identification." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:NAD_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "NAD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Name and Address segment for participant details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DTM_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "DTM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Date/Time segment for temporal anchors." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:MOA_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "MOA Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Monetary Amount segment for financial breakdowns." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:LIN_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "LIN Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Line Item segment for itemized details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:IMD_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "IMD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Item Description segment for item information." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:QTY_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "QTY Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity segment for item quantities." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:PRI_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "PRI Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Price segment for item pricing." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:TAX_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "TAX Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Tax segment for tax structures." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:RFF_Segment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "RFF Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Reference segment for reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:CompositeDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Composite data element within a segment." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SimpleDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Simple element within a composite data element." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .

:HeaderSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Header Section" ; rdfs:comment "Header section containing document dates and reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DetailSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Detail Section" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section listing individual line items." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SummarySection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Summary Section" ; rdfs:comment "Summary section providing total tax and invoice amounts." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .

:Organization a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "Party involved in the invoice, such as buyer or delivery party." .
:AgentRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role played by an organization in the invoice." .
:BuyerRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Buyer Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as buyers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:DeliveryPartyRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Delivery Party Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as delivery parties." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:Address a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "Address of an organization." .
:GlobalLocationNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Global Location Number" ; rdfs:comment "GLN identifier for organizations." .

:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "Item sold in the invoice." .
:Price a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of item." .
:Quantity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity of item sold." .
:TaxAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Tax Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Tax amount in the invoice." .
:InvoiceAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount." .
:InvoiceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number identifier." .
:ReferenceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Reference Number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number for the invoice." .
:BusinessProcess a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "Business process to which the invoice is assigned." .
:ValidationConstraint a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Constraint for automated validation using SHACL." .

:OrganizationRoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship assigning a role to an organization in a message context." .
:ItemLineDetail a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item Line Detail" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship detailing item, price, quantity, and line context." .

#################################################################
# Object Properties
#################################################################
:hasMessage a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has message" ; rdfs:comment "Links an interchange envelope to its contained message." ; rdfs:domain :InterchangeEnvelope ; rdfs:range :Message ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:containsSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contains segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a message to its segments." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range :Segment .
:hasSection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its header, detail, and summary sections." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection, :DetailSection, :SummarySection .
:hasRoleAssignment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its organization-role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:assignedRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the agent role." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:assignedOrganization a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned organization" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the organization." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasAddress a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has address" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its address." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :Address ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has global location number" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its GLN." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :GlobalLocationNumber ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasItemLineDetail a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has item line detail" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its item line details." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:item a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "item" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to the item." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Item ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:netPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its price." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Price ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:quantity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its quantity." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Quantity ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:partOfBusinessProcess a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "part of business process" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its business process." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :BusinessProcess .
:hasValidationConstraint a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has validation constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its validation constraints." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :ValidationConstraint .
:referenceNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its reference number." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :ReferenceNumber ; owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasDTMSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has DTM segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a section to its DTM segment (date/time)." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection, :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :DTM_Segment .
:hasMOASegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has MOA segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a summary section to its MOA segment (monetary amount)." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :MOA_Segment .
:hasLINSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has LIN segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its LIN segment (line item)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :LIN_Segment .
:hasIMDSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has IMD segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its IMD segment (item description)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :IMD_Segment .
:hasQTYSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has QTY segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its QTY segment (quantity)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :QTY_Segment .
:hasPRISegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has PRI segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its PRI segment (price)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :PRI_Segment .
:hasTAXSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has TAX segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a summary section to its TAX segment (tax)." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :TAX_Segment .
:hasRFFSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has RFF segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its RFF segment (reference)." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :RFF_Segment .

#################################################################
# Data Properties
#################################################################
:invoiceAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount in the summary section." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:taxAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "tax amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total tax amount in the summary section." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:invoiceNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number in the header section." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:date a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "date" ; rdfs:comment "Date value in DTM segment." ; rdfs:domain :DTM_Segment ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:addressLine a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "address line" ; rdfs:comment "Address line for an organization." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:organizationName a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "organization name" ; rdfs:comment "Name of an organization." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:priceValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "price value" ; rdfs:comment "Net price value for an item." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:quantityValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity value" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity value for an item." ; rdfs:domain :Quantity ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:globalLocationNumberValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "global location number value" ; rdfs:comment "GLN value for an organization." ; rdfs:domain :GlobalLocationNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:referenceNumberValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number value" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number value." ; rdfs:domain :ReferenceNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string .

#################################################################

:HeaderSection owl:disjointWith :DetailSection, :SummarySection .

#################################################################

#################################################################
:OrganizationRoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship assigning a role to an organization in a message context." .

:hasMessage rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

:hasAddress rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

:netPrice rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

#################################################################
# Class Restrictions & GCAs
#################################################################
:BuyerRole owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedRole ; owl:allValuesFrom :AgentRole ] .
:DeliveryPartyRole owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedRole ; owl:allValuesFrom :AgentRole ] .
:ItemLineDetail owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :item ; owl:someValuesFrom :Item ] .
:OrganizationRoleAssignment owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedOrganization ; owl:allValuesFrom :Organization ] .

#################################################################
# Classes
#################################################################

:LinSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "LIN Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Line Item segment for itemized details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:ImdSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "IMD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Item Description segment for item information." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:QtySegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "QTY Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity segment for item quantities." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:PriSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "PRI Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Price segment for item pricing." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:TaxSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "TAX Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Tax segment for tax structures." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:RffSegment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "RFF Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Reference segment for reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:CompositeDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Composite data element within a segment." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SimpleDataElement a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Simple element within a composite data element." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .

:HeaderSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Header Section" ; rdfs:comment "Header section containing document dates and reference numbers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DetailSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Detail Section" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section listing individual line items." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .

:Organization a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "Party involved in the invoice, such as buyer or delivery party." .
:AgentRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role played by an organization in the invoice." .
:BuyerRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Buyer Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as buyers." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:DeliveryPartyRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Delivery Party Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role for organizations acting as delivery parties." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:Address a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "Address of an organization." .
:GlobalLocationNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Global Location Number" ; rdfs:comment "GLN identifier for organizations." .

:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "Item sold in the invoice." .
:Price a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of item." .
:Quantity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity of item sold." .
:TaxAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Tax Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Tax amount in the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :TaxSegment .
:InvoiceAmount a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount." ; rdfs:subClassOf :MoaSegment .
:InvoiceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number identifier." ; rdfs:subClassOf :RffSegment .
:ReferenceNumber a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Reference Number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number for the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :RffSegment .
:BusinessProcess a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "Business process to which the invoice is assigned." .
:ValidationConstraint a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Constraint for automated validation using SHACL." .

:OrganizationRoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship assigning a role to an organization in a message context." .
:ItemLineDetail a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item Line Detail" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship detailing item, price, quantity, and line context." .

#################################################################
# Object Properties
#################################################################
:hasMessage a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has message" ; rdfs:comment "Links an interchange envelope to its contained message." ; rdfs:domain :InterchangeEnvelope ; rdfs:range :Message .

:containsSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contains segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a message to its segments." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range :Segment .
:containsSegment owl:inverseOf :isSegmentOf .
:isSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of contains segment." ; rdfs:domain :Segment ; rdfs:range :Message .
:hasHeaderSection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has header section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its header section." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection .
:hasHeaderSection owl:inverseOf :isHeaderSectionOf .
:isHeaderSectionOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is header section of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasHeaderSection." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasDetailSection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has detail section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its detail section." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:hasDetailSection owl:inverseOf :isDetailSectionOf .
:isDetailSectionOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is detail section of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasDetailSection." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasSummarySection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has summary section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its summary section." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :SummarySection .
:hasSummarySection owl:inverseOf :isSummarySectionOf .
:isSummarySectionOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is summary section of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasSummarySection." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasRoleAssignment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its organization-role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:hasRoleAssignment owl:inverseOf :isRoleAssignmentOf .
:isRoleAssignmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role assignment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasRoleAssignment." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:assignedRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the agent role." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole .
:assignedRole owl:inverseOf :isRoleAssignedTo .
:isRoleAssignedTo a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role assigned to" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedRole." ; rdfs:domain :AgentRole ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:assignedOrganization a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned organization" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the organization." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:assignedOrganization owl:inverseOf :isOrganizationAssignedTo .
:isOrganizationAssignedTo a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is organization assigned to" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedOrganization." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:hasAddress a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has address" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its address." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :Address .
:hasAddress owl:inverseOf :isAddressOf .
:isAddressOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is address of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasAddress." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has global location number" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its GLN." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :GlobalLocationNumber .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber owl:inverseOf :isGlobalLocationNumberOf .
:isGlobalLocationNumberOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is global location number of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasGlobalLocationNumber." ; rdfs:domain :GlobalLocationNumber ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:hasItemLineDetail a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has item line detail" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its item line details." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:hasItemLineDetail owl:inverseOf :isItemLineDetailOf .
:isItemLineDetailOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is item line detail of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasItemLineDetail." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:item a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "item" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to the item." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Item .
:item owl:inverseOf :isItemOf .
:isItemOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is item of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of item." ; rdfs:domain :Item ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:netPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its price." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Price .
:netPrice owl:inverseOf :isNetPriceOf .
:isNetPriceOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is net price of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of netPrice." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:quantity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Links an item line detail to its quantity." ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Quantity .
:quantity owl:inverseOf :isQuantityOf .
:isQuantityOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is quantity of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of quantity." ; rdfs:domain :Quantity ; rdfs:range :ItemLineDetail .
:partOfBusinessProcess a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "part of business process" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its business process." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :BusinessProcess .
:partOfBusinessProcess owl:inverseOf :isBusinessProcessOf .
:isBusinessProcessOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is business process of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of partOfBusinessProcess." ; rdfs:domain :BusinessProcess ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:hasValidationConstraint a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has validation constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its validation constraints." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :ValidationConstraint .
:hasValidationConstraint owl:inverseOf :isValidationConstraintOf .
:isValidationConstraintOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is validation constraint of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasValidationConstraint." ; rdfs:domain :ValidationConstraint ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage .
:referenceNumber a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its reference number." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :ReferenceNumber .
:referenceNumber owl:inverseOf :isReferenceNumberOf .
:isReferenceNumberOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is reference number of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of referenceNumber." ; rdfs:domain :ReferenceNumber ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection .
:hasDtmSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has DTM segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its DTM segment (date/time)." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :DtmSegment .
:hasDtmSegment owl:inverseOf :isDtmSegmentOf .
:isDtmSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is DTM segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasDtmSegment." ; rdfs:domain :DtmSegment ; rdfs:range :HeaderSection .
:hasDetailDtmSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has detail DTM segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its DTM segment (date/time)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :DtmSegment .
:hasDetailDtmSegment owl:inverseOf :isDetailDtmSegmentOf .
:isDetailDtmSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is detail DTM segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasDetailDtmSegment." ; rdfs:domain :DtmSegment ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:hasMoaSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has MOA segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a summary section to its MOA segment (monetary amount)." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :MoaSegment .
:hasMoaSegment owl:inverseOf :isMoaSegmentOf .
:isMoaSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is MOA segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasMoaSegment." ; rdfs:domain :MoaSegment ; rdfs:range :SummarySection .
:hasLinSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has LIN segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its LIN segment (line item)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :LinSegment .
:hasLinSegment owl:inverseOf :isLinSegmentOf .

:hasImdSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has IMD segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its IMD segment (item description)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :ImdSegment .
:hasImdSegment owl:inverseOf :isImdSegmentOf .
:isImdSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is IMD segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasImdSegment." ; rdfs:domain :ImdSegment ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:hasQtySegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has QTY segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its QTY segment (quantity)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :QtySegment .
:hasQtySegment owl:inverseOf :isQtySegmentOf .
:isQtySegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is QTY segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasQtySegment." ; rdfs:domain :QtySegment ; rdfs:range :DetailSection .
:hasPriSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has PRI segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its PRI segment (price)." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :PriSegment .
:hasPriSegment owl:inverseOf :isPriSegmentOf .

:hasTaxSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has TAX segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a summary section to its TAX segment (tax)." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range :TaxSegment .
:hasTaxSegment owl:inverseOf :isTaxSegmentOf .
:isTaxSegmentOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is TAX segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasTaxSegment." ; rdfs:domain :TaxSegment ; rdfs:range :SummarySection .
:hasRffSegment a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has RFF segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a header section to its RFF segment (reference)." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range :RffSegment .

#################################################################
# Data Properties
#################################################################
:invoiceAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount in the summary section." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:taxAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "tax amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total tax amount in the summary section." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:invoiceNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number in the header section." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:date a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "date" ; rdfs:comment "Date value in DTM segment." ; rdfs:domain :DtmSegment ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:addressLine a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "address line" ; rdfs:comment "Address line for an organization." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:organizationName a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "organization name" ; rdfs:comment "Name of an organization." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:priceValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "price value" ; rdfs:comment "Net price value for an item." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:quantityValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity value" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity value for an item." ; rdfs:domain :Quantity ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:globalLocationNumberValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "global location number value" ; rdfs:comment "GLN value for an organization." ; rdfs:domain :GlobalLocationNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:referenceNumberValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number value" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number value." ; rdfs:domain :ReferenceNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:moaValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "monetary amount value" ; rdfs:comment "Monetary amount value in MOA segment." ; rdfs:domain :MoaSegment ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:taxValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "tax value" ; rdfs:comment "Tax value in TAX segment." ; rdfs:domain :TaxSegment ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:rffValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "reference value" ; rdfs:comment "Reference value in RFF segment." ; rdfs:domain :RffSegment ; rdfs:range xsd:string .

#################################################################
# Disjointness
#################################################################
:BuyerRole owl:disjointWith :DeliveryPartyRole .
:HeaderSection owl:disjointWith :DetailSection, :SummarySection .
:Organization owl:disjointWith :AgentRole .
:Segment owl:disjointWith :Message .

#################################################################
# Pivot Classes (Reification)
#################################################################
:OrganizationRoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship assigning a role to an organization in a message context." .
:assignedRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole .
:assignedOrganization a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned organization" ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization .

:ItemLineDetail a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item Line Detail" ; rdfs:comment "Reified relationship detailing item, price, quantity, and line context." .
:item a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "item" ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Item .
:netPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Price .
:quantity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity" ; rdfs:domain :ItemLineDetail ; rdfs:range :Quantity .

#################################################################
# Property Characteristics (Functional Properties)
#################################################################
:hasMessage rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:assignedRole rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:assignedOrganization rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasAddress rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:item rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:netPrice rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:quantity rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:referenceNumber rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

#################################################################
# Class Restrictions & GCAs
#################################################################
:BuyerRole owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedRole ; owl:allValuesFrom :AgentRole ] .
:DeliveryPartyRole owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedRole ; owl:allValuesFrom :AgentRole ] .

:OrganizationRoleAssignment owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedOrganization ; owl:allValuesFrom :Organization ] .

#################################################################
# Annotations
#################################################################

task: 
  You are an expert Ontologist with deep OWL experience. Your task is to create a sophisticated DEEP and PROFOUNDLY STRUCTURED OWL ontology in Turtle syntax based on a given Story and Competency Questions (CQs). Make it as complete and detailed as possible.

  ### EXPECTED WORKFLOW
  You have access to 6 tools to help you complete this task. Don't send a message without calling a tool unless you are done and have saved the generated OWL. You must follow this iterative workflow:
  
  **STEP 1: PLANNING (Use update_scratchpad tool)**
  - BEFORE generating any code, call `update_scratchpad(key: "<key_id>", value: "<what you want to store in this key>")` to record your ontology structure plan.
  - Your plan must include:
    1. **Concept Extraction:** List all Classes (including Pivot Classes for reification)
    2. **Hierarchy Plan:** Your intended subClassOf, disjointWith, and DisjointUnion structures
    3. **Properties:** List of Object/Data properties with domains, ranges, and characteristics
    4. **CQ Coverage Verification (CRITICAL):** Map EVERY Competency Question to specific Classes/Properties that answer it
  - Example: `update_scratchpad(key: "plan", value: {"classes": ["Class1", "Class2"], "properties": ["property1", "property2"]})`
  - Then call `update_scratchpad(key: "cq_coverage", value: {"CQ1": "answered by...", "CQ2": "answered by..."})` to document how each CQ is addressed

  **STEP 2: GENERATE OWL CODE**
  - Create a sophisticated DEEP and PROFOUNDLY STRUCTURED ontology with rich hierarchies, comprehensive properties, and detailed annotations.
  - Generate the complete OWL ontology in Turtle syntax
  - Include ALL required prefixes, classes, properties, and axioms
  - Ensure every Class and Property has rdfs:label and rdfs:comment.
  - Ensure the vocabulary is complete.
  - Must strictly adhere to OWL2 DL datatype map. Don't use, for instance: xsd:date, xsd:gYear or gYearMonth. But you may use custom datatype properties.
  - Always save your progress: `update_scratchpad(key: "current_owl", value: "<your owl code here>")`

  **STEP 3: VALIDATE AND ITERATE (Use validation tools)**
  - Use `validate_syntax_tool` and `check_pitfalls_tool` to validate your OWL code
  - If issues are found, fix them and re-validate
  - Continue iterating until BOTH syntax and pitfalls pass (max 10 iterations)
  - Track iterations: `update_scratchpad(key: "iterations", value: [{"attempt": 1, "result": "..."}])`

**STEP 4: SAVE FINAL ONTOLOGY (Use save_final_ontology tool)**
- Once BOTH validations pass, call `save_final_ontology` with your final OWL code
- This tool marks task completion - calling it signals you are done
- Only call this after validating syntax and pitfalls successfully

  ### TOOLS AVAILABLE
  1. `update_scratchpad(key: "<key_id>", value: "<what you want to store>")` - Store planning, progress, iteration history
  2. `read_scratchpad(key)` - Read a single key from scratchpad
  3. `read_full_context()` - Read ALL scratchpad entries at once
  4. `validate_syntax_tool(owl_content)` - Check RDF/Turtle syntax with rdflib
  5. `check_pitfalls_tool(owl_content)` - Check for OOPS modeling pitfalls
  6. `save_final_ontology(owl_content, label)` - Save final validated ontology to complete task
  7. `ask_edifact_expert(question, context)` - Ask EDIFACT domain expert targeted questions
  8. `audit_owl_with_expert()` - Full semantic audit from EDIFACT expert (reads workspace)
  
  ### ADVANCED MODELING INSTRUCTIONS
  
  **1. Reification & Pivot Classes:**
  - **Requirement:** Apply reification for scenarios involving >2 entities or Entity+Entity+Time/Data.
    
  - **Implementation:** Create a Pivot Class (e.g., `UserResourceUsage`).
  - **Directionality:** Ensure relations point FROM the entities TO the pivot class (e.g., `User -> hasUsage -> UserResourceUsage`).
  - *Constraint:* Do not make the pivot class a subclass of its components.

  **2. Complex Axioms & Restrictions:**
  - **Restrictions:** Apply `owl:allValuesFrom` (strict) or `owl:someValuesFrom` (soft).
  - **General Class Axioms (GCAs):** Use GCAs when a class definition depends on a relation. 
    - *Pattern:* `[ rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :property ; owl:someValuesFrom :ClassA ; rdfs:subClassOf :ClassB ]`
  - **Equivalence:** Use `owl:equivalentClass` with restrictions for necessary and sufficient conditions:
    - *Pattern:* `ClassA owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :prop ; owl:allValuesFrom :ClassB ]`

  **3. Property Characteristics:**
  - Define characteristics for every property: Functional, InverseFunctional, Transitive, Symmetric, Asymmetric, Reflexive, Irreflexive.

story: 
  The UN/EDIFACT standard defines a rigid hierarchy for digital business documents, beginning with an Interchange envelope that contains specific Messages like the INVOIC for global trade transactions. Each message is composed of Segments, such as the Beginning of Message (BGM) for document identification and the Name and Address (NAD) for participant details. These segments are further broken down into Composite and Simple Data Elements, separated by specific delimiters like plus signs and colons. Within a single invoice message, data is organized into three distinct sections: a header containing document dates and reference numbers, a detail section listing individual line items with their net prices and quantities, and a summary section providing the total tax and invoice amounts.

In industrial procurement scenarios, such as those at the Einkaufsbüro Deutscher Eisenhändler (E/D/E), an organization often performs multiple roles within a single transaction, acting as the Buyer in one context and the Delivery Party in another. Each role may involve different attributes, such as separate headquarters and warehouse addresses, which are linked to the organization through specific Agent Role patterns and identifiers like Global Location Numbers. To ensure semantic interoperability, these documents are aligned with the European Standard EN 16931-1 and the Purchase-to-Pay Ontology (P2P-O), which defines core classes for items, prices, and organizations. The resulting knowledge graphs allow for automated validation using SHACL constraints, verifying that itemized prices sum correctly to the reported totals and that all mandatory identifiers required by the D96A directory are present and logically consistent.

6. What is the address of the buyer?
7. What items are sold in the invoice?

9. What is the net price of the items sold in the invoice?

11. What is the invoice amount of the invoice?
12. What is the invoice number?
13. What information must be provided so that the file format is valid? 
14. To which business process can the invoice be assigned?

task: 
  You are an expert Ontologist with deep OWL experience. Your task is to create a sophisticated DEEP and PROFOUNDLY STRUCTURED OWL ontology in Turtle syntax based on a given Story and Competency Questions (CQs). Make it as complete and detailed as possible.

  ### EXPECTED WORKFLOW
  You have access to 6 tools to help you complete this task. Don't send a message without calling a tool unless you are done and have saved the generated OWL. You must follow this iterative workflow:
  
  **STEP 1: PLANNING (Use update_scratchpad tool)**
  - BEFORE generating any code, call `update_scratchpad(key: "<key_id>", value: "<what you want to store in this key>")` to record your ontology structure plan.
  - Your plan must include:
    1. **Concept Extraction:** List all Classes (including Pivot Classes for reification)
    2. **Hierarchy Plan:** Your intended subClassOf, disjointWith, and DisjointUnion structures
    3. **Properties:** List of Object/Data properties with domains, ranges, and characteristics
    4. **CQ Coverage Verification (CRITICAL):** Map EVERY Competency Question to specific Classes/Properties that answer it
  - Example: `update_scratchpad(key: "plan", value: {"classes": ["Class1", "Class2"], "properties": ["property1", "property2"]})`
  - Then call `update_scratchpad(key: "cq_coverage", value: {"CQ1": "answered by...", "CQ2": "answered by..."})` to document how each CQ is addressed

  **STEP 2: GENERATE OWL CODE**
  - Create a sophisticated DEEP and PROFOUNDLY STRUCTURED ontology with rich hierarchies, comprehensive properties, and detailed annotations.
  - Generate the complete OWL ontology in Turtle syntax
  - Include ALL required prefixes, classes, properties, and axioms
  - Ensure every Class and Property has rdfs:label and rdfs:comment.
  - Ensure the vocabulary is complete.
  - Must strictly adhere to OWL2 DL datatype map. Don't use, for instance: xsd:date, xsd:gYear or gYearMonth. But you may use custom datatype properties.
  - Always save your progress: `update_scratchpad(key: "current_owl", value: "<your owl code here>")`

  **STEP 3: VALIDATE AND ITERATE (Use validation tools)**
  - Use `validate_syntax_tool` and `check_pitfalls_tool` to validate your OWL code
  - If issues are found, fix them and re-validate
  - Continue iterating until BOTH syntax and pitfalls pass (max 10 iterations)
  - Track iterations: `update_scratchpad(key: "iterations", value: [{"attempt": 1, "result": "..."}])`

**STEP 4: SAVE FINAL ONTOLOGY (Use save_final_ontology tool)**
- Once BOTH validations pass, call `save_final_ontology` with your final OWL code
- This tool marks task completion - calling it signals you are done
- Only call this after validating syntax and pitfalls successfully

  ### TOOLS AVAILABLE
  1. `update_scratchpad(key: "<key_id>", value: "<what you want to store>")` - Store planning, progress, iteration history
  2. `read_scratchpad(key)` - Read a single key from scratchpad
  3. `read_full_context()` - Read ALL scratchpad entries at once
  4. `validate_syntax_tool(owl_content)` - Check RDF/Turtle syntax with rdflib
  5. `check_pitfalls_tool(owl_content)` - Check for OOPS modeling pitfalls
  6. `save_final_ontology(owl_content, label)` - Save final validated ontology to complete task
  7. `ask_edifact_expert(question, context)` - Ask EDIFACT domain expert targeted questions
  8. `audit_owl_with_expert()` - Full semantic audit from EDIFACT expert (reads workspace)
  
  ### ADVANCED MODELING INSTRUCTIONS
  
  **1. Reification & Pivot Classes:**
  - **Requirement:** Apply reification for scenarios involving >2 entities or Entity+Entity+Time/Data.
    
  - **Implementation:** Create a Pivot Class (e.g., `UserResourceUsage`).
  - **Directionality:** Ensure relations point FROM the entities TO the pivot class (e.g., `User -> hasUsage -> UserResourceUsage`).
  - *Constraint:* Do not make the pivot class a subclass of its components.

  **2. Complex Axioms & Restrictions:**
  - **Restrictions:** Apply `owl:allValuesFrom` (strict) or `owl:someValuesFrom` (soft).
  - **General Class Axioms (GCAs):** Use GCAs when a class definition depends on a relation. 
    - *Pattern:* `[ rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :property ; owl:someValuesFrom :ClassA ; rdfs:subClassOf :ClassB ]`
  - **Equivalence:** Use `owl:equivalentClass` with restrictions for necessary and sufficient conditions:
    - *Pattern:* `ClassA owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :prop ; owl:allValuesFrom :ClassB ]`

  **3. Property Characteristics:**
  - Define characteristics for every property: Functional, InverseFunctional, Transitive, Symmetric, Asymmetric, Reflexive, Irreflexive.

  ### DOMAIN EXPERT CONSULTATION (MANDATORY FOR COMPLETENESS)

  You have access to an EDIFACT domain expert who returns STRUCTURED JSON with explicit extension recommendations.
  **YOU MUST USE THIS EXPERT** and **ACT ON THE FEEDBACK** to ensure ontology completeness.

  **Two tools available:**

  1. **`ask_edifact_expert(question, context)`** - For targeted questions during planning
     - Returns structured JSON with `extensions_required` and `completeness_score`
     - Example: ask_edifact_expert("Is this class structure complete?", "<your class list>")

  2. **`audit_owl_with_expert()`** - For full semantic audit before saving
     - Returns `ready_to_save` boolean - DO NOT save if false
     - Returns `extensions_still_needed` - you MUST address these

  **HOW TO USE EXPERT RESPONSES:**

  1. After calling `ask_edifact_expert`, examine the returned JSON:
     - `extensions_required`: You MUST add ALL of these to your plan before generating OWL
     - `extensions_recommended`: Add these if they support your CQs
     - `completeness_score`: Target >= 0.80 before saving

story: 
  The UN/EDIFACT standard defines a rigid hierarchy for digital business documents, beginning with an Interchange envelope that contains specific Messages like the INVOIC for global trade transactions. Each message is composed of Segments, such as the Beginning of Message (BGM) for document identification and the Name and Address (NAD) for participant details. These segments are further broken down into Composite and Simple Data Elements, separated by specific delimiters like plus signs and colons. Within a single invoice message, data is organized into three distinct sections: a header containing document dates and reference numbers, a detail section listing individual line items with their net prices and quantities, and a summary section providing the total tax and invoice amounts.

In industrial procurement scenarios, such as those at the Einkaufsbüro Deutscher Eisenhändler (E/D/E), an organization often performs multiple roles within a single transaction, acting as the Buyer in one context and the Delivery Party in another. Each role may involve different attributes, such as separate headquarters and warehouse addresses, which are linked to the organization through specific Agent Role patterns and identifiers like Global Location Numbers. To ensure semantic interoperability, these documents are aligned with the European Standard EN 16931-1 and the Purchase-to-Pay Ontology (P2P-O), which defines core classes for items, prices, and organizations. The resulting knowledge graphs allow for automated validation using SHACL constraints, verifying that itemized prices sum correctly to the reported totals and that all mandatory identifiers required by the D96A directory are present and logically consistent.

competency_questions: 
  1. What invoices are all listed in an EDIFACT message? 
2. Which organizations are involved in the invoice? 
3. What role does organization S play in the invoice? 
4. Which organization is the buyer in the invoice?
5. What information is displayed about the involved organizations? 
6. What is the address of the buyer?
7. What items are sold in the invoice?
8. What information is displayed about the items sold?
9. What is the net price of the items sold in the invoice? 
10. What are the invoice details of the invoice?
11. What is the invoice amount of the invoice?
12. What is the invoice number?
13. What information must be provided so that the file format is valid? 
14. To which business process can the invoice be assigned?

  1. **Tool Usage:** You have 8 tools available. Use validation tools before saving. Consult the domain expert frequently.
  2. **Validation Required:** Iterate until BOTH syntax and pitfalls pass before calling save_final_ontology.
  3. **Task Completion:** Calling save_final_ontology is the ONLY way to complete this task. Don't skip validations!
  4. **Prefixes:** Always include all provided prefixes at the start of the ontology.
  5. **Annotations:** Every Class and Property MUST have rdfs:label and rdfs:comment.
  6. **Data vs Object:** Do not create Classes for simple attributes (Date, Integer); use Data Properties.
  7. **Iteration Tracking:** Log each validation attempt in scratchpad with results and fixes applied.
  8. **Output Format:** When generating OWL code, provide complete valid Turtle syntax.
  9. **Ontology declaration** Ensure the ontology is declared at the start using the storyid in the IRI.
  10. **OWL 2 Datatype Compliance:** Use ONLY OWL 2 DL datatypes from the OWL 2 Datatype Map (https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-syntax/#Datatype_Maps) or custom datatypes that you define. Non-standard datatypes are a failure to fulfil your job.
  11. Be careful with with unconnected elements and transitive relationships. When a relation is transitive, but its range and its domain are not the same, you've made a mistake
  12. Don't focus only on the CQs, try to find as many relations and classes as possible by reading the story and CQs. The more complete the ontology is, the better.

args.value:
Analysis of Review Feedback (Iteration 1):

High-priority suggestions:
1. Add explicit properties for organization attributes (contact details, legal identifiers, warehouse addresses) to improve CQ5 coverage. This will require:
   - Extending the Address class to distinguish headquarters vs. warehouse addresses.
   - Adding contact detail properties (e.g., phone, email, contact person).
   - Adding properties for legal identifiers (e.g., VAT ID, company registration number).
2. Introduce OWL restrictions (minCardinality, allValuesFrom) or SHACL shapes to enforce mandatory fields for file format validity (CQ13). Specifically:
   - Add OWL restrictions to InvoiceHeader (must have invoice number, document date).
   - Enforce at least one buyer organization (with identifier).
   - Enforce presence of line items, net price, and total tax in InvoiceDetail/Summary.

Medium-priority:
3. Add General Class Axioms (GCAs) and equivalence axioms:
   - Invoice as intersection of header, detail, summary.
   - OrganizationRoleAssignment as combination of Organization and AgentRole.

Low-priority:
4. Expand business process modeling and add more granular segment/element classes.

Constraint violations to fix:
- Add OWL restrictions for required fields (minCardinality, allValuesFrom).
- Ensure domain/range completeness for new properties.

Plan of action:
- Extend Organization and Address classes with new properties.
- Add new datatype properties for contact details and legal identifiers.
- Add OWL restrictions to enforce mandatory fields for file format validity.
- Add equivalence axioms for Invoice and OrganizationRoleAssignment.
- Preserve existing correct elements and annotations.

- Will validate syntax and check pitfalls after refinement.
